name: spending-effort-with-jev
description: Shows which /effort level each message needs, the moment you send it, judged by TypeSafe's Jev, and switches on your OK. Based on 'Using Claude Code: Spending your effort'. Unofficial.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Your key for api.typesafe.ai (get one at https://typesafe.ai). Stored in secure storage.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the suggestions: en or zh.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: Only show a line when a switch is suggested or in effect, a hand-off needs a spec, or the key is rejected.

ask_first.title: Ask first
ask_first.description: When a message looks like it needs a different effort level (higher or lower), a dialog asks whether to switch before Claude starts. Off: a band above the prompt offers the switch without holding Claude up.

log_decisions.title: Log decisions
log_decisions.description: Keep a local log of Jev's probabilities and the plugin's decisions (numbers only, never message text) in the plugin's data folder, for tuning thresholds.

self_tune.title: Tune to my answers
self_tune.description: Once you've answered enough offers in a direction, make switches you keep taking come a little sooner and ones you keep turning down a little later (between 0.6 and 0.85).

subagents.title: Size subagents
subagents.description: Judge each subagent's task with Jev and run it on a fitting level (never above high), leaving the main conversation on yours.

interview.title: Interview before long runs
interview.description: When a long hands-off task leaves important requirements open, ask you two or three questions first and give Claude the answers.

midturn.title: Mid-turn downgrade hint
midturn.description: In a long high or max turn, check once whether the rest is mechanical, and if so offer low for the rest of that turn.
